1 · Intro

When to use it.

Add Assignment is used mainly for students, who often hold more than one job. Most staff have only one assignment, so Add Assignment is not a standard staff transaction.

In Oracle, a person has one person record, one or more work relationships, and one or more assignments inside each work relationship. The record the student already has tells you whether to add an assignment or a work relationship.

Use this whenA student already in Oracle is taking on another job, or you are setting up paid work for a student.

Before you submit

The same four checks on every pay-impacting transaction. Draft: the owner for this area confirms anything marked To confirm.

Attach

None named yet.

To confirmNo document is named yet, and whether a second assignment needs pre-approval from Compensation or your PCB consultant is an open item.

Check

Read every field back against the source document: person, effective date, position, hours, pay, and costing.

  • You started from the three-dot menu on an active assignment in Employment Info.
  • The new assignment points to an active position.
  • Payroll Details and Salary are included; Direct Reports only if the person will have direct reports.
  • Position Override toggles are checked, especially Manager Name.
  • Only one assignment is primary, and costing is added if the job shouldn't use the default.

Cutoff

Monthly (exempt) pay: the change must be fully approved by the HCM Transaction Cutoff, the 18th in most months and earlier in December. Check the HR/Payroll Calendar. Pending approvals do not pay. A change still waiting in approvals at the cutoff misses that payroll.

Who does what

  • Who starts it: You.
  • Who approves: To confirm: the approval chain for this transaction.
  • What happens next: Each assignment has its own costing, hours, and pay.

Watch-outs

  • Adding a Work Relationship when an E assignment exists creates a duplicate employment relationship that is hard to unwind.
  • Don't treat Add Assignment as a standard staff transaction. Most staff have only one assignment.
  • Don't let a position override replace the student's real manager. Check Manager Name before you leave its toggle on.
  • Each assignment has its own costing, hours, and pay.

  • Open item: confirm which action reasons to use for an added assignment.
  • Open item: confirm whether adding a second assignment needs approval.
  • Open item: confirm which assignment fields are mandatory.
  • Open item: confirm the rules for the primary flag: when to change it, which assignment should be primary, and what it affects.
  • Open item: confirm when an added assignment needs its own costing.
  • Open item: confirm whether starting from Employment Info is required or only recommended, and the exact Quick Action names.

HCM Academy job aid · Students

Add Assignment, or add a work relationship?

Use when: A student already in Oracle is taking on another job, or you are setting up paid work for a student. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. Search the student in Our Workforce > Employment Info and look at the work relationships.
  2. Only an enrolled student (N) record: add the employment Work Relationship.
  3. Already has an employee (E) assignment: add an assignment.
    • End it later with End Assignment
  4. Never create a second person record.
  5. Confirm the position for the new job is active.
  6. Open the student's Employment Info and find an active assignment.
  7. From that assignment's three-dot menu, select Add Assignment.
  8. Select the sections to include.
    • Payroll Details: include
    • Salary: include
    • Compensation: not needed
    • Direct Reports: only if the person will have direct reports
  9. Enter the start date, and whether the assignment is temporary or permanent.
  10. Select Add Assignment, then the action reason.
  11. Select the business unit and the active position.
  12. Check the Position Override toggles, especially Manager Name.
    • On (blue): take the value from the position
    • Off (gray): keep the assignment's current value
  13. Enter the required assignment information.
  14. Know what the primary flag means before you touch it.
    • Only one assignment can be primary
  15. Review, submit, and track approval.
  16. After approval, check the new assignment in Employment Info.
  17. Add costing if this job shouldn't use the default.
